patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than Sentry's shape. Choose Sentry only if your buying job matches “Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo annual wi” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage differs because AppDynamics is shaped for Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium ( whereas Sentry is shaped for Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; T. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; Sentry is Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo annual with default prepaid; Business $80/mo. Not a Datadog.
- Company-size focus: AppDynamics (mid-market, enterprise) vs Sentry (solo, micro, small-business).
- Researched limits: AppDynamics — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Sentry — Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job.

Limitations — AppDynamics: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); $6/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium $33 is; Sentry: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job; Prepaid event volume on Team/Business is the TCO lever beyond $26/$80 stickers.

Poor-fit cases: AppDynamics is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Sentry is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job · Avoid AppDynamics if you actually need Sentry's motion (Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
